response.overview: Synopsis:  "Paper Wish" follows a young boy initially consumed by boredom, who finds fleeting joy in crafting a paper airplane. His excitement is quickly dampened when his older sister dismisses his creation by carelessly throwing it away, and his attempt to recreate it with his sister's discarded exam paper leads to parental disappointment. Undeterred, he discovers a new inspiration in a graceful bird, leading him to meticulously fold a paper bird. While his sister's reaction remains indifferent, a chance encounter with his warm-hearted uncle, who genuinely appreciates his artistry and gifts him colorful paper and pencils, ignites his passion. This simple act of encouragement transforms his world, filling it with vibrant paper creations and newfound happiness, showcasing the profound impact of understanding and support on a child's spirit.
response.title: Paper Wish
